architecture.mechanism: Inter-turn short-circuit faults create parasitic circulation currents and localized heating that are detectable via negative-sequence current components generated by the asymmetry in the motor winding.
architecture.intervention: Perform a transient negative-sequence current analysis on the 3-phase supply lines using wavelet-based filtering and symmetrical component decomposition to identify incipient inter-turn shorts that do not alter the DC winding resistance.
architecture.expected_effect: Detection and isolation of the specific turn-to-turn fault, thereby eliminating the parasitic circulating currents and stopping the no-load overheating that trips the thermal overload.
architecture.falsification_test: If the motor continues to overheat on no-load even after injecting high-voltage pulses to verify the presence of inter-turn shorts or after confirming zero negative-sequence current via the wavelet filter, the mechanism is disproven.
